scope: Independent fixture preparation only; no production parser acceptance or dispatch claim

resolved_for_fixture.rule: Original UTF-8 bytes and decoded Unicode codepoints are indexed independently; byte/codepoint spans are half-open and columns are one-based codepoint columns.
CRLF contributes two bytes and two codepoints, advances one physical line after LF, and no selected token span splits the pair.

Fixture computes the existing code_snippet_sha256 contract independently: CRLF normalized to LF, selected one-based inclusive physical lines hashed without a terminal LF, with an exclusive end at the next line start excluded.
Decimal and integer magnitudes are recorded as strings; 1e-4 remains decimal kind with canonical value 0.0001, and betas retain decimal kind.
Only tomllib-accepted ordinary header/dotted-key examples are authored; promotion evidence is represented as declarations on one logical map node, without asserting untested parser behavior.

bounded_open_edges: The fixture does not freeze public error names, node-record wire schema, or all TOML subset behavior beyond the authored examples.
The fixture records selected exact spans and independent parser values; it does not claim whole-parser acceptance or implementation completeness.
Any later disagreement about TOML promotion or snippet line selection requires an Architect contract amendment before implementation acceptance.
